Daily Brief

Markets and policymakers face a convergence of crises today. Volkswagen's board approved cutting an additional 50,000 jobs—bringing total planned reductions to 100,000 by 2030—as the German automaker grapples with Chinese competition and falling profits [BBC Europe].
